<pre class='language-julia'><code class='language-julia'>begin
    using BayesianDoubleML
    using StableRNGs
    using PlutoUI
    using CairoMakie, DataFrames
end</code></pre>


<pre class='language-julia'><code class='language-julia'>begin
    # Generate the continuous-treatment exposure-response simulation design from Antonelli, Papadogeorgou, and Dominici (2022), Section 5.2.
    SEED = 33

    rng = StableRNG(SEED)

    # Generate data as DataFrame
    df = make_er_APD2022(StableRNG(SEED))
end;</code></pre>


<pre class='language-julia'><code class='language-julia'>begin
    # Set up the model

    model = BayesDRModel(df, :y, :d, treatment_type = :auto)

    # Fit the model using the suggested parameters from the paper
    fit!(
        model,
        n_samples = 2000,
        n_burn = 500,
        n_boot = 1000,
        thin = 2,
        n_chains = 1;
        rng = StableRNG(SEED)
    )

    summary(model)

end</code></pre>


<pre class='language-julia'><code class='language-julia'>fig = plot_exposure_response_curve(model)</code></pre>
<img height="600" src="data:image/png;base64, " style="object-fit: contain; height: auto;" width="900"/>
